A bill for an act relating to civil law; requiring actual notice for easements held by a government entity; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 117.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[117.80] ACTUAL NOTICE REQUIRED; EASEMENTS. +]

[+Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, a local, state, or any other government entity with an easement over private property must provide actual notice to an owner by mail, email, or telephone before using the easement. A municipality or state agency failing to provide actual notice under this section is subject to a civil penalty of $500 per violation. An owner aggrieved by a violation of this section may bring an action in district court to recover actual damages, any penalties under this section, costs, and reasonable attorney fees. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to civil law; requiring actual notice for easements held by a government entity; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 117.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[117.80] ACTUAL NOTICE REQUIRED; EASEMENTS.

Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, a local, state, or any other government entity with an easement over private property must provide actual notice to an owner by mail, email, or telephone before using the easement. A municipality or state agency failing to provide actual notice under this section is subject to a civil penalty of $500 per violation. An owner aggrieved by a violation of this section may bring an action in district court to recover actual damages, any penalties under this section, costs, and reasonable attorney fees.

An owner aggrieved by a violation of this section may bring an action in district court to recover actual damages, any penalties under this section, costs, and reasonable attorney fees.
